en.text: If we aren't careful, someone's going to get hurt.
If we aren't careful, someone will get hurt.

original: 気をつけないと、誰か怪我するよ。

en.text: If we aren't careful, someone will get hurt.
If we aren't careful, someone's going to get hurt.
If you're not careful, someone will get hurt.

original: 帰りは気をつけてね。

en.text: Be careful on your way back home.

original: 気をつけないとな。

en.text: I have to be careful.
I've got to be careful.

original: 車には気をつけなさいよ。

en.text: Be careful with the car.

original: 卵を落とさないように気をつけてね。

en.text: Be careful not to drop the eggs.

original: 次はもっと気をつけます。

en.text: Next time I'll be more careful.

original: 明日も、雪大変だと思うので気をつけてくださいね。

en.text: I think there'll be a lot of snow tomorrow as well, so be careful OK?
